fnol_text: My name is Ines Gallagher and I live at 545 Oakridge Avenue, Dover, DE 19925. You can reach me on (555) 390-5703 or ines.gallagher@example.com. After the torrential rain on the night of 23 May 2025, rainwater ran off the field behind us, across the back garden and in under the patio doors. About 5 cm of water covered the kitchen and family room floors. Policy HH-2024-00050. I'd like to claim for the damage to my home.

adjuster_notes.text: Called Mrs Gallagher on (555) 390-5703 to acknowledge the claim. Ines confirmed the loss date as 23 May 2025.
Site visit to 545 Oakridge Avenue. Neighbour Leila Quinlan was present and confirmed the timeline.
Ines sent photos and a contractor's estimate. Water line visible on walls.
